A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING.

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Something else on your mind?
Give us a call.

How much does pressure washing cost?+

Every property is different. The area to be cleaned, its condition, and the services you need help determine the price. Request a free estimate with a few details about your job so we can give you a project-specific quote.

Can I request more than one service?+

Yes. Choose all the services you need in your estimate request. You can ask about pressure washing, gutter cleaning, lawn care, and smaller cleanup jobs together.

Do you work with businesses, too?+

Yes. Lakeland Elite serves both homeowners and businesses in Lakeland and surrounding communities. Tell us about the property and the work you need in your request.

Is Lakeland Elite insured?+

Yes. Lakeland Elite carries general liability insurance. If your property manager needs documentation, ask for it when discussing your estimate.

How often should I plan for exterior care?+

Our usual starting point is annual house, roof, and driveway washing; gutter cleaning twice a year; and trash can cleaning quarterly. Your property’s trees, shade, condition, and surface materials may call for a different schedule. Ask us what makes sense for your place.
